title: Apple Has Released More Than 25 New Products in the Past Two Months
content:
Since late August, Apple has been on an absolute spree, releasing more than 25 new devices and accessories. Quite the start to the John Ternus era.


Below, we have recapped most of the new products that Apple has released over the past two months, with some available now and others still up for pre-order. This list is not entirely complete, as it does not include various Apple Watch bands, iPhone cases, and certain other accessories, but it covers most notable items.


  • Mac Mini With M6 and M5 Pro Chips

  • Mac Studio With M5 Max and M5 Ultra Chips

  • New Apple Polishing Cloth

  • iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max

  • iPhone Duo

  • Apple Watch Series 12

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • AirPods 5

  • Beats 360

  • Wrist Strap for iPhone 18 Pro and AirPods Pro 3

  • New Apple Watch Charging Puck

  • New Apple TV 4K and Siri Remote

  • HomePod Mini 2

  • Apple HomeView

  • New iPad Mini With OLED Display

  • New iPad Mini Smart Folio With TechWoven

  • New 14-Inch MacBook Pro With M6 Chip

  • New iMac With M6 Chip

  • MacBook Pro With PROLED XDR Display and Touch

  • New 70W/140W Power Adapters, Extension Cable, and World Travel Adapter Kit

  • Beats Pill Pokémon Special Edition
Barring any surprises, Apple has likely cleared through its slate of remaining major product announcements this year, but things will continue to be busy through at least mid-November as we wait for the HomeView, new Apple TV 4K and iPad mini, MacBook Pro models with OLED displays, and more to begin arriving to customers.
